Flow.description: Enrolls a patient in the Zenthera Patient Support Program (demo, fictional data). Reused by the Patient Support Program app, the Patient Services Agent and the PSP MCP server. Steps: validate inputs; refuse without consent; find the patient (Person Account) by first name, last name and full birthdate, using mobile to tell matches apart; refuse ambiguous matches without creating anything; refuse a duplicate open enrollment; otherwise create the patient if new and the Program Enrollment (Status Enrolled, Enrollment Date and Consent Date today). If the enrollment cannot be created, a patient created in the same run is removed. Outputs: isSuccess, resultCode (SUCCESS, VALIDATION_ERROR, NO_CONSENT, AMBIGUOUS_MATCH, DUPLICATE_ENROLLMENT, ERROR), resultMessage, patientId, enrollmentId, enrollmentNumber (ENR-...), patientStatus.

formulas.description: Message when several existing patients could be this person.
formulas.name: fxAmbiguousMultipleMessage
formulas.expression: "Not enrolled: more than one existing patient named " & {!firstName} & " " & {!lastName} & " with birthdate " & TEXT({!birthdate}) & " was found" & IF(ISBLANK({!mobilePhone}), " and no mobile number was given to tell them apart", " and the mobile number does not identify exactly one of them") & ". A coordinator must review the patient records. Nothing was created."

formulas.description: Message when the single name-and-birthdate match has a different mobile number on file.
formulas.name: fxAmbiguousMobileMessage
formulas.expression: "Not enrolled: an existing patient named " & {!firstName} & " " & {!lastName} & " with the same birthdate has a different mobile number on file. It is unclear whether this is the same person. A coordinator must review the patient record. Nothing was created."

formulas.description: Message when a patient with the same name has no birthdate recorded.
formulas.name: fxAmbiguousNoBirthdateMessage
formulas.expression: "Not enrolled: an existing patient named " & {!firstName} & " " & {!lastName} & " has no birthdate on file, so it may be the same person. Add the birthdate to that patient record or confirm it is a different person, then try again. Nothing was created."

formulas.description: Message when the enrollment failed and the new patient could not be removed.
formulas.name: fxCleanupFaultMessage
formulas.expression: "Not enrolled: the enrollment could not be created, and the patient record created in this attempt (Id " & {!varPatientId} & ") could not be removed. Ask an administrator to check it. Details: " & {!$Flow.FaultMessage}

formulas.description: TRUE only when consent is explicitly given. A blank value counts as not given.
formulas.name: fxConsentGiven

formulas.description: Message when an existing patient already has an open enrollment.
formulas.name: fxDuplicateMessage
formulas.expression: "Not enrolled: " & {!firstName} & " " & {!lastName} & " already has an open enrollment in the Zenthera Patient Support Program (" & {!Get_Open_Enrollment.Name} & "). A second enrollment was not created."

formulas.description: Message when the enrollment record cannot be created.
formulas.name: fxEnrollmentCreateFaultMessage
formulas.expression: "Not enrolled: the enrollment could not be created" & IF({!varCreatedNewPatient}, ", and the patient record created in this attempt was removed again", "") & ". Details: " & {!$Flow.FaultMessage}

formulas.description: The patient Id to return after an enrollment failure: only for an existing patient, because a new one was removed.
formulas.name: fxExistingPatientIdOnly

formulas.description: TRUE when a required input is missing, a value is not allowed, a text is too long, or the birthdate is in the future.
formulas.name: fxHasInvalidInput
formulas.expression: OR( ISBLANK({!firstName}), ISBLANK({!lastName}), ISBLANK({!birthdate}), ISBLANK({!therapy}), ISBLANK({!insuranceType}), AND(NOT(ISBLANK({!therapy})), {!therapy} <> "Zenthera 50 mg", {!therapy} <> "Zenthera 100 mg"), AND(NOT(ISBLANK({!insuranceType})), {!insuranceType} <> "Commercial", {!insuranceType} <> "Medicare", {!insuranceType} <> "Medicaid", {!insuranceType} <> "Uninsured"), LEN({!firstName}) > 40, LEN({!lastName}) > 80, LEN({!mobilePhone}) > 40, LEN({!prescriberName}) > 80, AND(NOT(ISBLANK({!birthdate})), {!birthdate} > {!$Flow.CurrentDate}) )

formulas.description: TRUE when a mobile number was given, the matched patient has one on file, and they differ.
formulas.name: fxMobileConflict

formulas.description: Message when the patient record cannot be created.
formulas.name: fxPatientCreateFaultMessage
formulas.expression: "Not enrolled: the patient record could not be created. Nothing was saved. Details: " & {!$Flow.FaultMessage}

formulas.name: fxSuccessMessage
formulas.expression: "Enrolled " & {!firstName} & " " & {!lastName} & " in the Zenthera Patient Support Program (" & {!therapy} & "). Enrollment number: " & {!Get_Created_Enrollment.Name} & ". " & IF({!varCreatedNewPatient}, "A new patient record was created.", "The existing patient record was used.")

formulas.description: Lists every missing or invalid input so the caller can ask for corrected values.
formulas.name: fxValidationMessage
formulas.expression: "Not enrolled. " & IF(ISBLANK({!firstName}), "First name is required. ", "") & IF(ISBLANK({!lastName}), "Last name is required. ", "") & IF(ISBLANK({!birthdate}), "Birthdate is required (YYYY-MM-DD). ", "") & IF(ISBLANK({!therapy}), "Therapy is required (Zenthera 50 mg or Zenthera 100 mg). ", "") & IF(ISBLANK({!insuranceType}), "Insurance type is required (Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid or Uninsured). ", "") & IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK({!therapy})), {!therapy} <> "Zenthera 50 mg", {!therapy} <> "Zenthera 100 mg"), "Therapy must be Zenthera 50 mg or Zenthera 100 mg. ", "") & IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK({!insuranceType})), {!insuranceType} <> "Commercial", {!insuranceType} <> "Medicare", {!insuranceType} <> "Medicaid", {!insuranceType} <> "Uninsured"), "Insurance type must be Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid or Uninsured. ", "") & IF(LEN({!firstName}) > 40, "First name must be 40 characters or fewer. ", "") & IF(LEN({!lastName}) > 80, "Last name must be 80 characters or fewer. ", "") & IF(LEN({!mobilePhone}) > 40, "Mobile must be 40 characters or fewer. ", "") & IF(LEN({!prescriberName}) > 80, "Prescriber name must be 80 characters or fewer. ", "") & IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK({!birthdate})), {!birthdate} > {!$Flow.CurrentDate}), "Birthdate cannot be in the future. ", "") & "Nothing was created."

variables.description: Required. Patient’s date of birth in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 1985-04-12. Used with the name to find an existing patient. Ask the user; never guess.
variables.name: birthdate

variables.description: Required. Must be true: the patient has agreed to join the program. If false or blank the enrollment is refused. Only set true when the user confirms the patient gave consent.
variables.name: consentGiven

variables.description: 18-character Salesforce Id of the created enrollment, or of the existing open enrollment when the result is DUPLICATE_ENROLLMENT. Blank otherwise.
variables.name: enrollmentId

variables.description: Enrollment number shown to users, for example ENR-0004 (created enrollment, or the existing one when the result is DUPLICATE_ENROLLMENT).
variables.name: enrollmentNumber

variables.description: Required. Patient’s first name, for example Asha. Maximum 40 characters.
variables.name: firstName

variables.description: Required. Patient’s insurance: exactly one of Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Uninsured.
variables.name: insuranceType

variables.description: True only when the enrollment was created.
variables.name: isSuccess

variables.description: Required. Patient’s last name, for example Patel. Maximum 80 characters.
variables.name: lastName

variables.description: Optional but recommended. Patient’s mobile number, for example +91 98765 43210. Used to tell apart patients with the same name and birthdate. Maximum 40 characters.
variables.name: mobilePhone

variables.description: 18-character Salesforce Id of the patient (Person Account) that was enrolled or already has an open enrollment. Blank when nothing was matched or created.
variables.name: patientId

variables.description: NEW_PATIENT when a patient record was created, EXISTING_PATIENT when an existing one was used. Blank when the flow stopped before matching.
variables.name: patientStatus

variables.description: Optional. Prescribing doctor’s full name, for example Dr. Anita Rao. Maximum 80 characters.
variables.name: prescriberName

variables.description: Outcome code: SUCCESS, VALIDATION_ERROR, NO_CONSENT, AMBIGUOUS_MATCH, DUPLICATE_ENROLLMENT or ERROR. Never retry automatically after ERROR.
variables.name: resultCode

variables.description: Plain-language result to show the user: confirmation on success, otherwise what went wrong and what to do.
variables.name: resultMessage

variables.description: Required. Prescribed therapy: exactly Zenthera 50 mg or Zenthera 100 mg.
variables.name: therapy

variables.description: Internal. True when this run created the patient record (used for cleanup if enrollment fails).

variables.description: Internal. Number of patients matching name and birthdate.
